# Ra.One Summary
Ra.One is a 2011 Indian science fiction film directed by Anubhav Sinha and produced by Shah Rukh Khan's Red Chillies Entertainment. The plot centers on Shekhar Subramaniam (Shah Rukh Khan), a video game developer who creates a game where the antagonist, Ra.One, is more powerful than the protagonist, G.One, for his son Prateek. Ra.One, imbued with self-learning AI and advanced superpowers including shapeshifting and mind reading, escapes the virtual world into reality, wreaking havoc as he seeks Prateek (alias "Lucifer"), who beat him in the game. G.One (also Shah Rukh Khan), modeled as a hero and brought into the real world by Prateek and programmer Jenny, fights to protect Prateek and Sonia (Kareena Kapoor) from Ra.One's relentless pursuit. The film showcases advanced visual effects, action set-pieces, and a soundtrack by Vishal–Shekhar with international artists like Akon.
Ra.One was notable for its extensive marketing campaign, international release across thousands of screens, and pioneering use of 3D and digital effects in Bollywood. The film received mixed critical reviews, with praise for its technical achievements and visual effects, but criticism for its story and character development. Box office performance was strong initially, setting records for Hindi film releases, but declined in subsequent weeks. Ra.One won several technical awards, including National Film and Filmfare Awards for Best Special Effects, and was recognized for its business and marketing strategy. Plans for a sequel were discussed but remained uncertain, with Shah Rukh Khan expressing interest in revisiting the concept if a suitable script is found.
